concerns.text: Task T015 bundles several distinct operations (composite‑score computation, per‑repo aggregation, Wilcoxon test, warning logic, and report generation) into a single checklist item. This is too coarse for deterministic execution; the downstream atomizer should split it into separate tasks (e.g., T015a compute composite score, T015b aggregate per‑repo means, T015c run Wilcoxon test, T015d generate final_report.json).

The verification step for T004 only runs the fetcher script and validates the JSON against the schema; it does not confirm that stratified sampling across the three popularity tiers (high, medium, low) with ≥ 5 repositories per tier, as mandated by FR‑010, was actually performed. Add a check (e.g., count per‑tier entries) to satisfy the requirement.

T019’s verification runs the validation script on a single artifact (`results_with_scores.json`). The specification requires the script to select the appropriate JSON schema after *each* major stage (dataset schema after extraction, results schema after coverage/similarity/stats). The verification should test at least two different schema‑artifact pairs to ensure dynamic selection works as intended.
